_comment: mode 'warn' forwards flagged calls but logs a loud FLAG event. mode 'enforce' blocks them outright. This repo ships in 'enforce' because allowed_tools/trusted_destinations below already cover every tool the demo servers use, so the demo (demo.py) can actually show a BLOCK. If you point this gateway at YOUR OWN server instead, switch back to 'warn' first, watch gateway_log.jsonl to see what would have been blocked, populate allowed_tools/trusted_destinations for your real usage, then flip to 'enforce'.
_sensitive_fields_comment: For these tools, check the named argument against trusted_destinations instead of just checking the tool name. Modeled on the WhatsApp MCP exfiltration case: the tool call itself was legitimate, only the destination wasn't.
